python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
layout = QVBoxLayout(%PARENT%)
layout.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 16, 14)
layout.setSpacing(0)
control = fluentqt.ToolTip(%PARENT%)
control.setWindowFlags(Qt.WindowType.Widget)
policy = control.sizePolicy()
policy.setRetainSizeWhenHidden(True)
control.setSizePolicy(policy)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
control.show()
control.setAnimationEnabled(True)
anchor = fluentqt.Button("Archive", %PARENT%)
anchor.setFixedSize(112, 32)
anchor.clicked.connect(lambda: control.setVisible(not control.isVisible()))
layout.addStretch(1)
layout.addWidget(control, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignHCenter)
layout.addWidget(anchor, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignHCenter)
layout.addStretch(1)

effectHint.en: Controls the fade transition when clicking Archive in the preview to hide/show the tooltip; toggling alone will not replay an open bubble.
effectHint.zh: 控制点击预览区“Archive”按钮切换气泡显隐时的渐隐渐现过渡；气泡已打开时仅切换此开关不会重播动画。

description.en: ToolTips attach to a target widget. Click Archive in the preview to hide or show the tooltip bubble.
description.zh: 提示气泡会附着在目标控件旁，点击预览中的“Archive”按钮可切换显示与隐藏。
